UC-STR-002.decision: Continuity manifest V2: REQUIRED recordedSegmentCount, partIndex===sequence, duplicate-sequence refusal, head/tail coverage for COMPLETE, SEGMENT_UPLOAD_LOST/SEGMENT_WRITE_FAILED/BROADCAST_PAUSED limitations that forbid COMPLETE, gaps only as INTERRUPTED+SEGMENT_UPLOAD_LOST. Server seal restructured per lead review into three steps, no transaction open while hashing (ET-ACQ-04): (A) short tx under the capture-session advisory lock loads the session + declarations, runs the mode planner against that exact snapshot (declared SCREEN_SEGMENT parts are the authoritative expected set; manifest part must follow them), passes governance, and CLAIMS the session (status stays ACTIVE, endReason = CAPTURE_SEAL_CLAIM.endReason 'SEAL_IN_PROGRESS', claim timestamp = updatedAt; lease 10 min, in packages/shared capture-limits.ts); (B) outside any transaction: manifest classing, manifest facts, storage size checks, completeEvidence with the claimed declaration snapshot as expectedSha256ByPartIndex (refuses any part set differing from the plan); (C) short tx under the lock binds claim -> BOUND with final endReason + case link in one commit. While a claim is live, declarations, reserve, discard and other seals answer SESSION_BUSY (409, retryable); a failed non-terminal hash releases the claim back to ACTIVE; a terminal digest refusal interrupts; a stale claim is reclaimed by the next seal, cleared by a declaration, and released by the capture reaper (which never expires a session under a live claim). The client reconciles recorded vs declared via the pure src/continuous-manifest.ts.

migrationNotes: No migration needed for the seal claim: an ACTIVE capture session's endReason is always NULL, so endReason='SEAL_IN_PROGRESS' on an ACTIVE row unambiguously marks the claim, and CaptureSession.updatedAt (set by the claim write; nothing else writes a claimed row) is its timestamp. If the lead prefers explicit columns, the equivalent hardening is: ALTER TABLE capture_sessions ADD COLUMN seal_claimed_at_utc timestamptz NULL; CREATE INDEX capture_sessions_seal_claim_idx ON capture_sessions (seal_claimed_at_utc) WHERE seal_claimed_at_utc IS NOT NULL; (Prisma: sealClaimedAtUtc DateTime? @map("seal_claimed_at_utc") @db.Timestamptz(6)) — then isLiveSealClaim reads that column instead of endReason/updatedAt.
